name: Craftsman Automation Ltd
_note: Fact base as of 30-Sep-2026. Rs crore unless stated; consolidated. Every number carries a source and its publication date. Q2FY27 results (Nov-2026) and the Sep-2026 shareholding are after the as-of date and are not used.

business.what: A Coimbatore-based contract manufacturer of machined metal parts, founded in 1986 by Srinivasan Ravi (CMD). Three segments: Powertrain (cylinder blocks and heads, camshafts, transmission parts, bearing caps and turbocharger parts machined for CV, tractor, off-highway and stationary-engine makers, plus castings for large engines from Germany and the new Kothavadi foundry); Aluminium Products (high-pressure, low-pressure, gravity and sand die-cast and machined parts for 4W and 2W makers, structural parts, EV battery housings, alloy wheels; DR Axion India and Sunbeam Lightweighting are in this segment); Industrial & Engineering (storage solutions: racking, shelving, vertical stores and automated storage and retrieval; material handling, gears and gearboxes, special-purpose machines, toolroom, contract manufacturing).
business.plants: 31 facilities: 28 vertically integrated plants across 9 Indian states, 2 under construction (Hosur, Chennai/Sriperumbudur for DR Axion) and 1 in Germany (Fronberg Guss); 3.8 million sq ft built-up (Q1FY27 presentation, slide 5).
business.employees: 3,040 permanent employees in the parent company (AR FY26 board report annexure); the group also uses contract labour.
business.customers: Sells to CV, PV, 2W, tractor, off-highway, genset/gas-engine, power transmission and material-handling makers; does not name customers on calls. One customer contributed Rs1,143.8 cr (24% of standalone revenue) in FY26 vs Rs1,364.2 cr (35%) in FY25 (AR FY26 standalone note 3.12b).
business.exports: Standalone revenue outside India Rs312.6 cr in FY26 (6.5% of standalone; FY25 Rs236.7 cr). Germany (Fronberg Guss) is ~16-19% of powertrain revenue (FY26 16%, Q1FY27 19%).
business.src: AR FY26; Q1FY27 and Q4FY26 presentations

q1fy27.segments: Powertrain Rs623 cr (+26%), EBIT Rs114 cr (18.3%); Aluminium Rs1,479 cr (+38%), EBIT Rs150 cr (10.1%); Industrial & Engineering Rs330 cr (+53%), EBIT Rs30 cr (9.1%).
q1fy27.beat: Emkay: revenue 9% above its estimate (12% above the street), EBITDA 8% above; EBITDA margin 15.8%, -30bp q-o-q (31-Jul-2026).
q1fy27.src: Q1FY27 presentation slides 8-13 (30-Jul-2026); Screener.in (as reported); Emkay result note (31-Jul-2026)

guidance.growthFY27: 'Truly double digit, most probably in the mid-teens' revenue growth for FY27, assuming aluminium prices stay where they are (CMD, Q4 call, 8-May-2026).
guidance.aluminium: Aluminium business ~Rs6,500 cr in FY27 'just an approximation... please negate that if it is taken as a guidance'; first goal US$1 bn in aluminium in 2-3 years; margin will not rise 100-200bp next year 'at this rate' because new capex 'will again spoil the margins' (Q4 call).
guidance.largeEngines: Large stationary-engine (data-centre gensets) castings and machining: US$100 mn a year by FY30 from 6 customers (orders from 4-5 received); ~30% of that run-rate productionised in FY28, ~50% in FY29; revenue 'very low single digit' share of powertrain in FY27 (Q4 and Q1 calls).
guidance.sunbeam: Restructuring 90% complete by Dec-2026; exits loss-making legacy parts and customers (revenue may fall 10-20%); EBITDA margin 'mid-teens' by Q4FY27, in line with Craftsman (Q1 call, 30-Jul-2026). Was 'still at single-digit' in FY26 (Q4 call).
guidance.capex: FY27 ~Rs1,500 cr 'conservatively': standalone >Rs1,000 cr (as in recent years), DR Axion ~Rs430 cr approved (may spill into FY28), Sunbeam maintenance; may be raised in Q3/Q4 if demand holds. Maintenance capex alone Rs250-300 cr; depreciation 'close to Rs500 cr' (Q1 call).
guidance.leverage: Net debt / EBITDA 2.43x (Mar-26, company), to fall below 2x in FY27 and then to 1.5x; 'there's no ever need to come to the public markets' again (Q4 and Q1 calls). Excluding the Gurgaon (Sunbeam) land, held for sale, debt should be read as ~Rs2,700 cr rather than Rs3,100 cr (Q4 call); land sale 'close to signing a deal' (Q1 call).
guidance.utilisation: Powertrain ~70% (optimum ~75-80%); aluminium >80%; large-engine lines ~10% (Q4 and Q1 calls).
guidance.src: Q4FY26 call transcript (13-May-2026); Q1FY27 call transcript (4-Aug-2026)

corporateActions.what: IPO on BSE/NSE (listed 25-Mar-2021); fresh issue Rs150 cr plus an offer for sale.
corporateActions.src: Q1FY27 presentation slide 5; Screener cash flow FY21 (Rs146 cr proceeds)

corporateActions.what: Acquired 76% of DR Axion India (aluminium castings for 4W makers, Tiruvallur).
QIP: 27,27,272 shares at Rs4,400 (Rs1,200 cr); shares 2.11 cr to 2.39 cr (+12.9%).
Bought the remaining 24% of DR Axion for Rs250 cr (wholly owned from 1-Jul-2024).

Craftsman Germany GmbH bought; Craftsman Fronberg Guss took over the assets of a German iron foundry (large-engine crankcases, cylinder heads) on 1-Oct-2024; consideration EUR57,000 for the shell company.

Sunbeam Lightweighting Solutions (aluminium die-casting, Gurgaon/NCR) acquired: 100% of securities for Rs1 plus Rs376 cr of OCDs, then Rs230 cr more OCDs (Rs606 cr in all). Contributed Rs585 cr revenue and a Rs32 cr pre-tax loss from Oct-2024 to Mar-2025; pro forma full-year FY25 revenue Rs1,237 cr and a Rs232 cr pre-tax loss.
corporateActions.src: AR FY26 standalone note; AR FY25/FY26 business-combination note

corporateActions.what: DR Axion bought Suprash Developers (and its subsidiary Srikara Technologies) for Rs145.8 cr: ~50 acres next to SIPCOT Sriperumbudur for a new DR Axion plant (commissioning by Dec-2026). A scheme to merge DR Axion, Suprash and Srikara into Sunbeam has been filed.
corporateActions.src: AR FY26 board report; Q4FY26 call

corporateActions.what: QIP: 22,98,850 shares at Rs8,700 (Rs2,000 cr; floor Rs8,966); shares 2.386 cr to 2.615 cr (+9.6%). HDFC Flexi Cap took 16.5% of the issue, SBI Multicap 6%, HDFC Life and SBI Life 5% each. Objects: capex, prepaying debt and working capital.

CMD Srinivasan Ravi sold 5.25 lakh shares (2.01%) in a block deal at ~Rs9,250 (Rs486 cr); his stake fell from 40.15% to 38.14%; lock-up afterwards (180 days or 18 months: reports differ). The company received nothing.

otherIncomeFY26.src: AR FY26 consolidated note 2.2 (Rs lakh converted)

management.cmd: Srinivasan Ravi, founder, Chairman & MD (mechanical engineer, PSG College of Technology; ~40 years in the industry).
management.wtd: Ravi Gauthamram, Whole Time Director (promoter group; MS Production Systems Engineering, RWTH Aachen); on the board since Feb-2014.
management.cfo: C.B. Chandrasekar (CFO); COO Thiyagaraj Damodharaswamy; CS Shainshad Aduvanni.
management.board: Six directors: two executive promoters and four independent directors (Sundararaman Kalyanaraman, Vijaya Sampath, T.S.V. Rajagopal, Rajeswari Karthigeyan). The CMD is also chairman.
management.pay: FY26: CMD Rs11.94 cr (salary Rs6.05 cr + commission Rs5.86 cr; +112%; 169x the median employee); WTD Rs4.00 cr (+108%; 54x). Together ~4% of FY26 PAT. Median employee pay +8%.
management.auditor: Statutory auditors Sharp & Tannan, Chennai (unmodified 'true and fair' opinion on the FY26 consolidated accounts; key audit matter: capitalisation of property, plant and equipment); internal auditors Kumbhat & Co.
management.src: AR FY26 corporate governance report and remuneration annexure; Q1FY27 presentation slide 16

accounting.exceptional: Exceptional items: FY25 -Rs25.5 cr, FY26 -Rs13.0 cr (AR FY26 consolidated segment note: Rs2,547 lakh and Rs1,295 lakh); quarterly FY26: Q1 -Rs8.2 cr, Q2 -Rs0.5 cr, Q3 -Rs3.7 cr, Q4 -Rs0.5 cr (Screener). Screener books them in other income.
accounting.minorities: DR Axion's 24% minority until Jun-2024: Screener's Net Profit row was before minorities in FY23-FY25 (patched to 'Profit for EPS').
accounting.acquisitionCosts: Rs12.4 cr of deal costs expensed in FY25.
accounting.goodwill: Intangible assets Rs206 cr at Mar-26 (DR Axion goodwill and others); land Rs1,190 cr at Mar-26 after the Sunbeam purchase (Rs990 cr at Mar-25), of which the Gurgaon land is held for sale.
